players.product: Susquehanna nuclear + PJM baseload gas generation contracted to data centers (Amazon ~2 GW PPA, powered-land sites)

quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 results: $473 million of adjusted EBITDA and $350 million of adjusted free cash flow; CFO: adjusted EBITDA 'more than doubled and adjusted free cash flow quadrupled year-over-year', driven by the Freedom and Guernsey acquisitions (closed Q4 last year), higher prices and spark spreads, higher capacity and ROR revenues that started in June 2025, and the ongoing AWS PPA ramp.
quarterly_data.figure: $473 million adjusted EBITDA; $350 million adjusted free cash flow

quarterly_data.signal: Fleet generated approximately 16 TWh in Q1 at a 55% fleet-wide capacity factor as intermediate and peaking assets (Montour, Martins Creek) ran more; PJM saw approximately 3% incremental deliveries on a weather-adjusted basis vs Q1 2025 — 'demand continues to increase with no meaningful increase in supply'. Susquehanna Unit 1 refueling outage 'progressed well' with the unit 'synced back to the grid yesterday' (CEO: in startup, 'slightly exceeding our planned outage duration').
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 16 TWh; 55% fleet-wide capacity factor; approximately 3% incremental PJM deliveries (weather-adjusted)

quarterly_data.signal: Reaffirmed 2026 guidance (excludes the pending Cornerstone acquisition; update promised after closing): adjusted EBITDA $1.75 billion-$2.05 billion and adjusted free cash flow $980 million-$1.18 billion; forecasted 2026 net leverage 3.1x (ex-Cornerstone) vs a long-term target below 3.5x.
quarterly_data.figure: adj EBITDA $1.75 billion-$2.05 billion; adj FCF $980 million-$1.18 billion; net leverage 3.1x

quarterly_data.signal: Preliminary 2027/2028 outlook (includes Cornerstone, spark spread expansion through 3/31 and the new financing): base case free cash flow approximately $34 per share in 2027 and approximately $36 per share in 2028, 'a 15% improvement from our January estimates'; with the buyback program (70% of available free cash flow) approximately $41 per share in 2028, 'a 30% increase'; implied free cash flow yield about 11%. Upside levers named: accretive M&A, 'acceleration of the Amazon ramp established in our existing PPA', new data center contracting and further spark spread expansion.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately $34 per share (2027); approximately $36 per share (2028); approximately $41 per share (2028 with buybacks); about 11% FCF yield

quarterly_data.signal: Cornerstone acquisition: FERC 203 application filed in January (approval anticipated by this summer), HSR waiting period expired in March, Indiana order anticipated by this summer; close expected 'as soon as this summer'. Financing already raised: $4 billion of senior unsecured notes (five and seven year tranches, blended rate just above 6.25%), used partly to retire the $1.2 billion 8.625% senior secured notes (more than $40 million per year interest savings); one additional month of ownership valued at approximately $30 million of cash flow.
quarterly_data.figure: $4 billion senior unsecured notes; $1.2 billion notes retired; more than $40 million per year interest reduction; approximately $30 million per month

quarterly_data.signal: Data center development pipeline: 'several 1+ GW opportunities for long-term PPAs' at existing and other Pennsylvania sites; land of up to 3,000 acres that can support 3 GW-4 GW of data center capacity (zoning ranges from fully zoned to in process, e.g. Montour); ability to install new generation of 500 MW-1 GW at several sites; a mix of gas and storage projects totaling over 2 GW (CTs, batteries, CCGTs) submitted into PJM's Cycle 1 Interconnection Study Cluster. Hybrid model: existing generation for speed to market, new build later, only on long-term offtake agreements or a PJM RBP award; initial development is capital light. Also active in Ohio, where Talen has 'over 4 GW gas fleet' including the Indiana plant.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 3,000 acres; 3 GW-4 GW data center capacity; 500 MW-1 GW new generation per site; over 2 GW gas and storage projects

quarterly_data.signal: Contracted profile: when the existing nearly 2 GW PPA reaches full ramp (including Cornerstone), 35% of gross margin is contracted long term with 'a AA credit counterparty' — the largest revenue stream; 'For every incremental 1 GW PPA that we secure, our long-term contracted gross margin increases by 15%, meaning that our next 1 GW PPA may increase our long-term contracted gross margin to 50%.'
quarterly_data.figure: 35% contracted gross margin; +15% per incremental 1 GW PPA; 50% with next 1 GW PPA

quarterly_data.signal: PJM pricing: summer and forward spark spreads continue to rise on tight fundamentals; spark spreads improved by approximately $5 a megawatt-hour since the 3/31 pricing date beyond what the outlook shows ('several more dollars per share if marked today'). Management expects the widened West Hub-PPL zonal basis (attributed to transmission work, not fundamentals) to revert; 'A $5 a megawatt-hour impact across 30+ TWh in PPL Zone' is cited as upside, each lever offering '10%+' further FCF/share growth.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately $5 a megawatt-hour; 30+ TWh in PPL Zone; 10%+ additional FCF per share growth

quarterly_data.signal: New-build economics and RBP: CEO says new CCGTs are being discussed at '$3,000-$4,000' and that batteries and peakers are the least-cost fix for a roughly 50-hour-a-year reserve problem; merchant economics leave a wide gap, so new build needs a hyperscaler bilateral contract or an RBP award (Talen will participate in both). PJM is now targeting RBP timing for this fall; CEO: hyperscaler capital plans 'just continue to, you know, reach escape velocity... it's not slowing down.' New-gen options do not include uprates/repowerings of existing assets.

contracts.signal: Q1 2026 results were driven in part by 'the ongoing AWS PPA ramp'; at full ramp the existing nearly 2 GW PPA puts 35% of Talen's gross margin under long-term contract with 'a AA credit counterparty', its largest revenue stream; 'acceleration of the Amazon ramp established in our existing PPA' is named as an upside lever to the 2027/2028 outlook.
contracts.value: 35% of gross margin contracted long term at full ramp
